title: Eliminate 123 duplicate head reads in the pinned-edit replay (no κ)
body:
## Summary

The complete repaired pinned-edit scanner rereads every pinner at head, including files whose bytes its immutable-tree diff already proves unchanged. This opt-in package reuses those base bytes. On the fixed canonical replay it eliminates **123 head blob requests and 5,882,040 payload bytes**, preserving the complete 154-row report and exit behavior.

Claim type: scoped implementation-preservation proof with exact finite comparison and observed work counts. Timing is inconclusive; no runtime speedup or new kappa is claimed. This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas.

```diff
- read head bytes for every merge-base pinner
+ read head bytes for changed pinners
+ reuse base bytes for unchanged pinners
```

The proof uses the original `--no-renames` tree diff: a merge-base pinner absent from its modified/deleted/type-changed set has the same bytes at head. The scanner's search, classification, target multiplicities, ordering and default/strict policy are unchanged. The new implementation is frozen at this first verified reduction.

Credit Armin Pourshafeie / apoursh, #6319, for the original scanner; ToikY, #6357, for the exact source-read repairs used here; and their retained source/integrity lineage. Their source-read correctness is a cited dependency, not this contribution's audit deliverable. The exact PR6357 scanner at `170867c0a8f92375dfc489dd090bad5daee7b090` is exported with its original notices and SHA256, so no unmerged Git object is needed for replay.

## Evidence

- **Before:** the canonical comparison `de5ec2e7a6074068452f45b1a191b5c72832df4a` to `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a` requests 124 head pinner blobs, returning 19,620,947 payload bytes.
  **After:** it requests one changed pinner, returning 13,738,907 payload bytes. All 154 complete pin rows agree, including 153 advisory stale rows, one repinned row and zero frozen stale rows. Both base-loading phases are unchanged. These are returned payload bytes, not filesystem I/O or memory measurements.
- A separate synthetic Git history checks twelve expected rows, all three classification states, duplicate target digests, changed/unchanged/removed/added pinners, LF/CR filenames, CLI stdout and exits, the empty diff and three rejected adapter modes. Normal and optimized checks remain active without Python assertions.
- Ten fresh complete commands, five alternating pairs, all returned identical stdout without errors. Original median 21.064 s, range 20.770 to 21.347; reuse median 21.403 s, range 20.532 to 21.536. The ranges overlap. The separate profiled run spent only 0.189 of 19.944 s in all blob-loading calls, limiting possible runtime gains here. The generated `BENCHMARK.json` records every run and binds its source/output hashes.
- Local CPython 3.12.15 checks pass: direct normal in 41.27 s, direct optimized in 41.93 s, registered replay of both in 85.21 s. Metadata/pins pass. Committed-byte/source-history preflight passes for all eleven declared files at `40591325403a9897ca95f642345742d17b1bd2a0`. Each registered command is below five minutes locally.

From the worktree root, with full Git history and the standard library:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/pinned-edit-read-reuse
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/pinned-edit-read-reuse/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/pinned-edit-read-reuse/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/pinned-edit-read-reuse --check-source-history
```

Use an installed CPython 3.12 path elsewhere. The direct verifier generates `PASS_PINNED_EDIT_READ_REUSE` with actual request/byte counters and source/package hashes. Set `TMPDIR` to an external scratch directory as needed. The README gives both complete scanner commands and the optional benchmark command.

[Advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19361579). Canonical main remained unchanged at submission. Live open PRs, claims, merged searches and main's README text were refreshed; sparse cached-note coverage was incomplete and is not a novelty certificate.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

This is an opt-in tooling package. It changes no shared scanner, CI gate, frozen input or selected result. The equivalence proof assumes the predecessor's supported path/encoding contract and valid, stable Git objects. It does not preserve failures caused solely by a redundant read of a corrupt or concurrently removed object. There is no cross-scan cache.

The predecessor's broader source-reader admission and native Windows lifetime obligations remain separate. No supplier admission, selected cold replay, compiler/native/ownership/precision/tape/recovery proof, Lean or Docker check was run. All five selected framework assumptions remain. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Open next questions

Can the tree-wide digest search avoid decompressing repeated objects while preserving binary/text treatment and every substring match? First specify a blob-ID deduplication algorithm, expand its matches back to every filename and compare one complete historical report. Those semantics are unresolved here; no further optimization was attempted.

## Related open work

- #6319 supplies the original scanner, policy and proposed integration. This package adds a read-reuse step and leaves integration to that work.
- #6357 repairs exact path framing and repository selection. Its exact scanner is the retained predecessor; this result preserves that reader and does not deliver another repair audit.
- #5721 changes Windows process ownership in the shared Git blob reader. This package supplies no new Windows lifecycle contract or validation of that proposal.

## CI notes

Both hosted checks passed at `40591325403a9897ca95f642345742d17b1bd2a0` in [run 41537223436](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41537223436): [plan](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41537223436/job/125592025884) in 4m36s and [registered package replay](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41537223436/job/125594310736) in 2m8s. The completed checks were confirmed once; run metadata confirms the matching head, completed status and successful conclusion.

The registered replay executes both normal and optimized commands. Local normal/optimized behavior checks, registered replay, source pins and committed-byte/source-history checks also passed. Hosted success certifies execution of these bounded checks. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review remain unclaimed.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast Radius:** package.

Only `research/pinned-edit-read-reuse/` is added. The shared scanner and selected frontier are unchanged.
